name: Effect: Strained Metabolism
text:
Granted by Strained Metabolism

Mild Backlash You become Enfeebled 1 and Clumsy 1 until you take a bite of food (which usually requires 2 Interact actions: one to retrieve the food and another to consume it).

Moderate Backlash You are enfeebled 1, clumsy 1, and Fatigued until you can eat a full meal, which requires at least 10 minutes.

Severe Backlash You become Sickened 2 as nausea wracks you, and you are also enfeebled 1 and clumsy 1 until you can eat a full meal (which requires you to no longer be sickened). You are fatigued until you can get a full night's rest.
